description: A polished personal portfolio website presenting Yashika Hidau's profile, skills, projects, and contact options.

services.name: Portfolio website
features: Hero, about, skills, projects, and contact sections
Project cards with only user-provided destinations: Alqora https://alqora-demo.vercel.app and Opsfront https://opsfront-dakrbnt5w-yashikas-projects-76231cf3.vercel.app/#
Corporate Registry and Stepwise Events have no outbound links because their URLs are unavailable
Real social/contact links and contact actions
Subtle Framer Motion animations and Lucide icons

questions.question: Which language should the portfolio frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for maintainable, type-safe Next.js development.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript without static type annotations.

questions.rationale: The requested Next.js App Router portfolio is best served by TypeScript.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and routing approach should be used?

options.label: Next.js App Router
options.description: Use Next.js App Router for the requested portfolio.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a different framework or routing approach.

questions.rationale: Next.js App Router is explicitly requested.

questions.question: Are there any additional frontend features or constraints?
questions.answer: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide icons; responsive luxury dark design; hero, about, skills, projects, and contact sections; real links/contact actions; accessible and performant implementation.
questions.rationale: These are the requested design and implementation requirements.

questions.question: Which data stores does the project require?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The portfolio is a client-rendered/static frontend and does not need persistent storage.

questions.rationale: The requested scope is a frontend-only portfolio with no persistence or file uploads.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?

options.label: No
options.description: Visitors browse the portfolio without signing in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must sign in to use application features.

questions.rationale: The portfolio has no authenticated application features.
